author: Thr33pw00d
quote: This is not Grand, not Theft and not Auto. Game is locked in 30 fps and sometimes it even goes below that. For the first 7 hours you play a chores simulator simulator with dating simulator sprinkled here and there. You can't pull guns and rob stuff in many areas nor kill specific group of people. There are game breaking bugs everywhere and you don't even need to force them or look for it. Writing for this game is dated and is diverges a lot from the tone other games of the series feel. For a 99 dollars games this is inexcusable.

Nice graphics, lots of sony's money everywhere, recycled ideas from previous games, same narrative structure as the first game, bad gameplay, mechanics are actually making the player bored and the classic Kojima lore dump 2 hour cutscenes.

Next game better focus more on gameplay rather than on cutscenes.

author: Thr33pw00d
quote: This game is not canon. It's a big attempt to destroy the franchise legacy by Ron Gilbert for not having worked on anything Monkey Island from MI2 forward. Game tries hard to discredit anything that came after the last time Ron Gilbert had any input in the series in 1991 with a revisionist approach and pretending Curse of Monkey Island, MI4 and Tell Tale games didn't happen. Words can't describe how much I hate this game and those who made it happen.

author: Thr33pw00d
quote: Wanted a new Wario Land for a long time, but I don't think I even need one now after this. Please play this game if you haven't already, it's rare to get a new platformer that's as amazing as Pizza Tower anymore. I also never make genuine reviews on Steam so that alone should tell you how awesome this game is if I went out of my way to do it for once.
